---
title: "Module 3A: WGCNA Input and Soft-Threshold Diagnostic"
author: "Helen Hoxie"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

**Purpose.** Build the WGCNA input matrix and compute the scale-free topology
diagnostic used to choose the soft-thresholding power. The power is a judgment
made by a person reading the diagnostic plot; this module does not choose it.

This module stops after the diagnostic. Before running Module 3B:

1. Inspect `results/WGCNA/SoftThreshold.pdf` and `soft_threshold_candidates.csv`.
2. Record the chosen power, your name and the date in `config/runs/<run_id>.json`
   (created by this module on first run).

Module 3B refuses to run if no power is recorded, or if the input fingerprint
in the run record no longer matches the matrix produced here.

**Input.** Expression values (`v_mrna$E`, log2-CPM after `filterByExpr` and TMM)
from Module 2, restricted to the gene types in `config.json: de$gene_types`.
voom expression values do not depend on the design matrix, so the Module 2
object serves as variance-stabilized WGCNA input.

**Outputs** (relative to `project_dir`):

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `data/processed/wgcna_datExpr.rds` | samples x genes matrix, top genes by variance |
| `results/WGCNA/SoftThreshold.pdf` | scale-free fit and mean connectivity by power |
| `results/WGCNA/soft_threshold_candidates.csv` | fit indices per candidate power |
| `config/runs/<run_id>.json` (repository) | run record, created if absent; never overwritten |

**References.** Langfelder & Horvath (2008) BMC Bioinformatics 9:559 (WGCNA).


```{r setup}
source(here::here("scripts", "helpers", "config.R"))
source(here::here("scripts", "helpers", "run_record.R"))
cfg <- load_config()
start_log(cfg, "Module_3A_WGCNA_Diagnostic")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(WGCNA)
  library(dplyr)
})
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
allowWGCNAThreads(nThreads = cfg$compute$wgcna_threads)
set.seed(cfg$compute$seed)

wg <- cfg$wgcna
wgcna_dir <- proj_path(cfg, "results", "WGCNA")
dir.create(wgcna_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Run ID:", cfg$run_id, "\n")
cat("Gene types:", if (is.null(cfg$de$gene_types)) "all" else paste(cfg$de$gene_types, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Top genes by variance:", wg$top_n_by_variance, "| network type:", wg$network_type, "\n")
```


## 1. Input matrix

```{r input_matrix}
v_mrna <- readRDS(proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "v_mrna.rds"))
master_samples <- readRDS(proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "master_samples.rds"))

expr <- v_mrna$E
stopifnot(setequal(colnames(expr), master_samples$barcode))
expr <- expr[, master_samples$barcode]
cat("Expression matrix from Module 2:", nrow(expr), "genes x", ncol(expr), "samples\n")

gene_var <- apply(expr, 1, var)
n_top <- min(wg$top_n_by_variance, nrow(expr))
top_genes <- names(sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(n_top)]
datExpr <- t(expr[top_genes, ])
cat("Genes selected (top", n_top, "by variance):", ncol(datExpr), "\n")
cat("Variance at selection cutoff:", signif(gene_var[top_genes[n_top]], 3), "\n")

gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr, verbose = 0)
cat("goodSamplesGenes allOK:", gsg$allOK, "\n")
stopifnot(gsg$allOK)

saveRDS(datExpr, proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "wgcna_datExpr.rds"))
rm(v_mrna, expr, gene_var, top_genes, gsg)
invisible(gc())
```


## 2. Soft-threshold diagnostic

```{r soft_threshold}
powers <- wg$soft_power$candidate_range
r2_threshold <- wg$soft_power$r2_threshold

sft <- pickSoftThreshold(datExpr, powerVector = powers,
                         networkType = wg$network_type, verbose = 0)

fit <- sft$fitIndices %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    power        = Power,
    signed_R2    = -sign(slope) * SFT.R.sq,
    slope        = slope,
    mean_k       = mean.k.,
    median_k     = median.k.,
    meets_criterion = signed_R2 > r2_threshold
  )
write.csv(fit, file.path(wgcna_dir, "soft_threshold_candidates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Selection criterion (config):", wg$soft_power$selection_criterion, "\n")
cat("R^2 threshold:", r2_threshold, "\n\n")
print(fit %>% dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(signed_R2, slope), ~ round(.x, 3)),
                            dplyr::across(c(mean_k, median_k), ~ round(.x, 1))),
      row.names = FALSE)

plot_soft_threshold <- function() {
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
  plot(fit$power, fit$signed_R2, type = "n", ylim = range(c(fit$signed_R2, r2_threshold, 0)),
       xlab = "Soft threshold (power)", ylab = expression("Scale-free fit, signed " * R^2),
       main = "Scale independence", cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1, cex.main = 1.3)
  abline(h = r2_threshold, col = "red", lty = 2)
  text(fit$power, fit$signed_R2, labels = fit$power, col = "red", cex = 1.1)
  plot(fit$power, fit$mean_k, type = "n",
       xlab = "Soft threshold (power)", ylab = "Mean connectivity",
       main = "Mean connectivity", cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1, cex.main = 1.3)
  text(fit$power, fit$mean_k, labels = fit$power, col = "red", cex = 1.1)
}
pdf(file.path(wgcna_dir, "SoftThreshold.pdf"), width = 11, height = 5.5)
plot_soft_threshold()
invisible(dev.off())
plot_soft_threshold()
```


## 3. Run record

```{r run_record}
fp <- wgcna_fingerprint(datExpr, cfg$de$gene_types)
cat("Input fingerprint:\n")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(fp, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE), "\n\n")

rec_path <- run_record_path(cfg)
if (!file.exists(rec_path)) {
  create_run_record(cfg, fp)
  cat("Run record created:", rec_path, "\n")
  cat("Next: fill wgcna_power$selected_value, selected_by and selected_on, then run Module 3B.\n")
} else {
  rec <- read_run_record(cfg)
  if (fingerprints_match(rec$wgcna_power$input_fingerprint, fp)) {
    cat("Existing run record matches this input. Recorded power:",
        if (is_missing(rec$wgcna_power$selected_value)) "not yet recorded" else rec$wgcna_power$selected_value, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("WARNING: the existing run record was made on a different input.\n",
        "Its recorded power does not apply to this matrix, and Module 3B will refuse to run.\n",
        "Re-read the diagnostic, then replace input_fingerprint with the fingerprint above\n",
        "and update selected_value, selected_by and selected_on.\n")
  }
}
```


```{r cleanup_and_session_info}
rm(datExpr, sft, fit, fp)
invisible(gc())
stop_log()
```
